title: Say Sakey ya Angawat na Surah
intro: Isipen pa so sakey a mapaabeban kamarerwa ya onaasingger ed sakey ed saray Sugo nen Allah a walaan na puson napno na inkamatua tan aralem a pilalek a manaral. Balet diad saman a mismon bekta, sakey a toon mayaman tan walaan na kipapasen so angalay imano na Mensahero, tan walay kinmurong to ed samay manaanap. Say tinmumbok et sakey labat ya kapitulo na Quran, ya imbaki pian ipetek so Mensahero tan igalang so kamarerwa ya linma ya manaanap.
clues: Linma ak ed sakey a mensahero nen Allah ya walay lukas a puso tan aralem a pilalek parad panangigiya
Anggapoy nayarin iter ko ed mundon kipapasen, sakey labat a mapaabeban kamarerwa ya manaanap na katuaan
Agmakanengneng iray pisikal a matak, balet malinew so pakanengneng ko ed espiritual
Sinmabi ak ed agmakapaliket a bekta, nen say Mensahero et okupado ed sakey a toon walaan na baleg ya impluensya
Walay akaarap ed siak, balet inmebat si Allah na madibinon panangipetek
Siak si Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, say debosyonadon kaiba ya say istorya to so angitonton ed Surah Abasa

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum
Bilal ibn Rabah
Mu'adh ibn Jabal
Zayd ibn Thabit
Salman al-Farisi

trial.label: Trial / Event
options: Say pangipulisay ed sikato na Propeta parad sakey a mayaman a too
Say pangibantak ed mansasnit ya apoy na saray kalaban
Say inlako tan pinasegsegang bilang aripen
Say pangabet na sakey a mabiskeg a mibabakal ed sakey a duel
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
trial.answer: Say pangipulisay ed sikato na Propeta parad sakey a mayaman a too

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey a kapitulo na Quran ya onggapo ed sakey a kurong (Surah Abasa)
Say apoy ya ginawan ambetel tan maligen
Sakey a baston ya mamabiig ed mabiskeg a dayat
Sakey a biong ya impaalagey ed atagey a palandey
Sakey a manok ya ginawa manlapud pinaawet a pitek
location.answer: Sakey a kapitulo na Quran ya onggapo ed sakey a kurong (Surah Abasa)

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Imparungtal nen Allah so sakey a Quranic surah ya mangidedepensa ed siak
Ginawa nen Allah ya ambetel tan ligtas so apoy parad siak
Inbiig nen Allah so dayat pian nisalba to ak ed panguusil
Inikdan ak nen Allah na baleg a panarian tan kakabatan
Inawit ak nen Allah ed tawen ya anggapoy patey
outcome.answer: Imparungtal nen Allah so sakey a Quranic surah ya mangidedepensa ed siak

verse: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]. (80:2)
